notes.title: 1.1 Content Patch Update + Good news for Corals!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33142166/5fbd86bd7bb63930edad4725e1cd0ea9a6ba9b94.jpg[/img]

Hey! You may have seen Koral got updated. This update brings stability to the game build, adds ultra wide screen support and fixes some minor bugs, including a bugged Steam Achievement. 

Here you can find the complete changelog:

- Fixed Out of Bounds bug in the first section of the cave.

- Fixed Out of Bounds bug in the musical part of "Deeps"

- Fixed achievement bug in "Descent"

- Added ultra wide screen support via commands. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/896750/discussions/0/1651043958640560312/]see how here[/url])

- Fixed some floating corals in "Garden"

- Added more happiness and colors to some reefs :D

On the other hand, today was a good day: Corals are evolving in some areas of the world to be stronger against climate change, hot temperatures and extreme climate. See more about that here:

https://www.businessinsider.com/scientists-discovered-super-coral-that-has-been-thriving-in-warm-and-acidic-water-in-hawaii-2019-5?IR=T

Big hug,

Carlos.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33142166/bd17f2d5dec7a389b6eaf7bc69738e2bb12cef54.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Making of Koral - The game about the sea done in the sea
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33142166/ec7b6ebb6b9385ccceeff611c75c5092d352919c.jpg[/img]

Koral has a really special development. It was done in a sailship in a paradise in northen catalonia called Cap de Creus. What better way to make a game about the sea than going to the sea and make it there!

We recorded the entire process and made a convenient 19 min Making Of for you all to enjoy. You can watch in in youtube. English and Spanish captions avivable.

[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UD5eqrRbfDs]Watch the Making Of the game in YouTube.[/url][/h1]

Kind regards,

Carlos.
